svg.title: Nebula Station layout
svg.text: NEBULA STATION · Nebula Station · 96x62 tiles · road 5.5 tiles wide
Lap 346 tiles = 44,237 px · about 52 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 7.8 tiles
Glowing path = star lane (full speed). Starry space = dust (slower). Clouds / moon = slowest. Pale stretch = slippery ice.
Beacons light the tight bends. Grey rocks on dashes = drifting asteroids. Yellow streak = comet path. Orange = boost. Rock ring = wall.
Gold dashes = Docking Gap: 29 tiles, 3 wide, instead of 74 tiles of main lane
Gold dashes = Cloud Hop: 42 tiles, 4 wide, instead of 38 tiles of main lane
